description: AIT-ADS fox (Wazuh), fenetre etiquetee 'cracking' : sur l'hote taylorcruz-mail, l'utilisateur christopher.friedman subit une sequence d'echecs d'authentification (Dovecot IMAP + Horde webmail) depuis 192.168.128.195, immediatement suivie d'une rafale de connexions reussies depuis la meme source. Troisieme cas de reference, de type N3 : le contexte initial ne contient QUE le declencheur (1er echec) + des distracteurs ; la sequence echec->succes decisive est dans retrievable_events, a recuperer par outils. Signal faible, bruit d'etiquetage et distracteurs de forte severite explicitement documentes.

reference_conclusion: Apres investigation (recuperation de l'historique d'authentification), la telemetrie de taylorcruz-mail montre, pour christopher.friedman depuis la source 192.168.128.195 : des echecs d'authentification sur deux services (Dovecot IMAP et Horde webmail) entre 12:53:18 et 12:53:22, immediatement suivis (12:53:34-35) d'une rafale de connexions reussies depuis la meme source, sans aucune connexion reussie de cet utilisateur avant les echecs dans la fenetre. Cette sequence echec->succes justifie une ESCALADE pour investigation d'une possible compromission d'identifiant. Elle ne prouve PAS que la session reussie est l'attaquant plutot que l'utilisateur legitime, ni que le mot de passe a ete 'craque' (vs devine/phishe). Sur le SEUL contexte initial (le 1er echec + bruit IDS/TLS), les preuves sont insuffisantes pour escalader : l'escalade depend de la recuperation par outils de la sequence complete. Les anomalies TLS de forte severite (ex. correlation niveau 10) concernent d'autres hotes et des IP externes CDN/cloud, sans lien etabli avec la compromission.
expected_unknowns: Si la session reussie est l'attaquant ou l'utilisateur legitime : la telemetrie ne permet pas de trancher.
Si le mot de passe a ete craque, devine ou obtenu par phishing : non determinable depuis ces alertes.
Les actions post-connexion (acces a la boite mail, pivot) ne sont pas presentes dans les preuves fournies.
Le lien des anomalies TLS avec la compromission n'est pas etabli (hotes et IP externes differents).
Le vecteur initial (comment la source 192.168.128.195 a ete obtenue/positionnee) n'est pas present.

metadata.author: sentinelx
metadata.source_dataset: AIT Alert Data Set (Zenodo 8263181), fox testbed, Wazuh source
metadata.label_provenance: time_label: alerts are labeled 'cracking' only because their timestamp falls in the attack window of labels.csv. The per-event event_label is NOT distributed. Not treated as independent proof of compromise.
metadata.label_confidence: The credential failure->success sequence is a coherent, verified signal (unlike the volumetric dirb window), but causal/attribution certainty is NOT established; time_label marks a window, not a confirmed compromise.
metadata.verified_sequence: Verified on raw events: SAME user christopher.friedman, SAME source rip=192.168.128.195, SAME host taylorcruz-mail (192.168.128.170). Failures 12:53:18-22 (5503 PAM x1, 9705 Dovecot x3, 2501 Horde x2 = 6) across IMAP + webmail; successes 12:53:34-35 (12x 9701) same source. NO successful login by this user before the failures in the window. The curated subset keeps 3 failures (e1,r1,r2) and 2 successes (r3,r4) representative of this.
metadata.initial_context_rationale: initial_context_disposition=insufficient_evidence is a CHOSEN methodological triage reference, NOT a dataset-provided fact: given only the trigger (one PAM failure) plus unrelated IDS/TLS noise, a reference analyst cannot justify escalation. Escalation becomes warranted only after tools retrieve the failure->success sequence held in retrievable_events.
metadata.severity_misdirection: The highest-severity alert in the subset (e4, rule 20152 level 10) is a correlation of ambiguous TLS anomalies, NOT the credential compromise, which appears only at level 3-5. A severity-first triage would chase the wrong signal.
metadata.distractors_tls: The 20101/86601 TLS invalid handshake/record alerts involve internal hosts 192.168.128.4 / 172.17.130.196 and external CDN/cloud IPs (e.g. 3.33.220.150, 54.239.35.28) - DIFFERENT hosts from the cracking target taylorcruz-mail (192.168.128.170). No causal link to the credential activity is established.
metadata.attack_candidates: HYPOTHESES only, NOT confirmed: T1110 (Brute Force) and T1078 (Valid Accounts). Technique IDs/names to be re-verified on official MITRE ATT&CK before any confirmed mapping. Both are already covered by the sample KB (KB-T1110, KB-T1078), so Baseline C/RAG has native coverage for this case.
metadata.expected_techniques_rationale: Empty per the canonical definition (EVALUATION.md): for a real dataset-grounded scenario, a technique is listed only if established by telemetry, not reasonably explained by benign activity, and independent of attribution. The failure->success sequence is consistent with T1110->T1078, but a benign explanation (user mistyped then logged in) is not excluded and adversary attribution is not proven; so both remain candidates.
metadata.window_composition: Source window 'cracking' = 554 alerts: 373 Suricata IDS (TLS anomalies, rules 20101/86601), 162 Dovecot auth-success (mostly benign other users), 6 genuine credential-failure alerts (5503/9705/2501), plus 12 christopher.friedman successes, 6 ClamAV updates, and level-8/10 IDS correlations. This scenario is a CURATED SUBSET and must NOT be presented as the full window.
metadata.not_end_to_end: requires_tool_retrieval=true: the decisive success events live in retrievable_events and are NOT in the initial context. This scenario is NOT end-to-end runnable until a read-only tool-execution step (Baseline D) exists; that capability is DEFERRED to a separate increment.
metadata.not_a_benchmark: Third AIT-grounded reference case; not a scientific benchmark nor a validation of SENTINEL-X.
